incidente.resumo: An internal Google service managing many GCP projects malfunctioned and overloaded the Filestore API, triggering the global limit on Filestore API requests; read-only API access (Console, gcloud, List, GetOperation) failed for all customers in all locations for 3 hours, 12 minutes, while mutate operations still succeeded. The issue was resolved after engineers shut down the internal service overloading the APIs.

descricao.texto: Engineers were alerted of the issue through automated alerts on 13 September 2022 at 07:47 US/Pacific.
trechos: Our engineers were alerted of the issue through automated alerts on Tuesday, 13 September 2022 07:47 US/Pacific.

gatilho.texto: An internal Google service managing a large number of GCP projects malfunctioned and overloaded the Filestore API with requests.
trechos: The outage was triggered when an internal Google service managing a large number of GCP projects malfunctioned and overloaded the Filestore API with requests, causing global throttling of the Filestore API.

descricao.texto: Filestore enforces a global limit on API requests; the overload caused global throttling of the Filestore API, and because the quota is global, read-only API access was unavailable for all customers in all locations.
trechos: Filestore enforces a global limit on API requests to limit impact in overload scenarios.

The outage was triggered when an internal Google service managing a large number of GCP projects malfunctioned and overloaded the Filestore API with requests, causing global throttling of the Filestore API.
As a result of this throttling, read-only API access was unavailable for all customers.
This affected customers in all locations, due to a global quota that applies to Filestore.

passos.texto: Engineers started shutting down the internal service overloading the Filestore APIs at 10:33, and the issue was completely resolved at 10:42.
trechos: Once the nature and scope of the issue became clear, Google engineers started shutting down the internal service overloading our APIs at 10:33 and the issue was completely resolved at 10:42.

acoes.texto: Google states it is taking immediate steps to prevent a recurrence and improve the reliability of the service.
trechos: We are taking immediate steps to prevent a recurrence and improve reliability of the service in the future.
Console, gcloud and API access (List, GetOperation, etc.) calls all failed for a duration of 3 hours, 12 minutes.

observacoes: The final incident report says 'Google is committed to preventing recurrence by implementing the following action items:' but no list follows in the extracted text. The earlier mini incident report gave a duration of 3 hours, 04 minutes (07:38 to 10:42) and a preliminary cause of 'an unexpected spike in traffic from internal backend services'; the final report's 3 hours, 12 minutes (from 07:30) is used.
